messages.author: 72f2ccabe1e5089f
messages.subject: Usage information for count detectors
parts:
Hi
I need to reduce the binary data from a multi-occasion survey to be a count for a single occasion. The data are in a 3D array and I can easily sum over the occasion dimension to get the frequency of captures but I am unsure how to correctly set the usage for the traps object.

I first summed the original binary usage matrix to get a count of the number of days operational for each trap and tried to assign this to the trap object as follows: 

count.usage <- apply(usage(traps),1,sum)
usage(traps) <- count.usage

But the resulting usage info retains the occasion dimension and so ends up repeating the count multiple times (one for each of the original occasions). I'm not sure if this is actually a problem or when fitting to data from one occasion only the first column will be used?

I also tried changing the attribute for the trap object (attr(traps,"detector") <- "count"), first setting the usage to be NULL, and I also looked at using the reduce function but that appears to mainly be for when one wants to reduce into clusters of traps and so does not seem to help here.

Please advise.

Many thanks!

Greg

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Usage information for count detectors
parts:
reduce() does many things, including this. It is used for this very purpose within secr.fit() in the 'fastproximity' case:
      capthist <- reduce(capthist, by = 'all', outputdetector = 'count'...)
You could consult the code for reduce.traps if you want to do it the hard way.
Murray
